reports.title: Project SIMILARITY: Learning Routed Timing Laws for Architecture Search
reports.summary: A causal study of operand-distribution topology as a routed timing variable, with held-out prediction and prospective two-candidate deployment.
reports.result: 96 / 96 corrected routes · 0.3039 ns held-out MAE · 36 / 36 unseen cases

reports.title: Closed-Loop Physical-Design Search
reports.summary: A fixed-budget search loop that uses routed observations to choose which accelerator designs to implement next.
reports.result: 8 / 8 new routes · 6.475% Fmax MAPE · 12 / 12 workloads improved

reports.title: Kernellum Compiler and Physical-Evidence Pipeline
reports.summary: An evidence-aware compiler pipeline from quantized models and generated RTL through synthesis, final-route measurement, and the K2 board handoff.
reports.result: 96.44% INT8 accuracy · 450 / 450 cycle-model matches · 0.9441 routed rank ρ

evidence.title: Evidence & Reproducibility
